description:
Configure a new X12 Billing Partner in LibreHealth EHR for electronic claims submission. 

1. Log in to LibreHealth EHR (admin/password).
2. Navigate to the Practice settings (Administration > Practice > X12 Partners) or similar billing configuration menu.
3. Create a new X12 Partner record for 'Availity Clearinghouse'.
4. Use the following technical specifications:
   - Name: Availity Clearinghouse
   - ID Number: AVAIL001
   - Processing Format: 5010 (or ANSI X12 5010)
   - Sender ID (ISA06): 193847502
   - Receiver ID (ISA08): AVAILITY
   - Version: 005010X222A1

Ensure the record is saved and visible in the list.
